### Address Change History  
**Document in System:**  
```
Address Change Log:
Timestamp: 2026-01-15 14:30 UTC
Old Address: 123 Oak Lane, Manchester, M1 1AA, UK
New Address: 456 Elm Street, New York, NY 10001, USA
Change Type: Permanent relocation
Initiated By: Customer (online)
Verified By: John Smith (CSR)
Proof of Address: Utility bill (dated Jan 10, 2026)
KYC Status: Verified
AML Status: Cleared (US address, low-risk)
Change Request ID: ADDR-REQ-00001
Status: Approved
```  
**Keep 6-Year Audit Trail** (per [[policy_retention]])

raw_entities.name: Address Change Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for processing customer address changes, including verification by customer service staff, proof of address validation, and compliance clearance. The process captures the change request, maintains audit trail for 6 years, and updates KYC and AML status.

raw_entities.name: Address Change Initiation
raw_entities.description: Customer initiates address change request through online channel, providing old and new address details and change type classification.
context: Old Address: 123 Oak Lane, Manchester, M1 1AA, UK
New Address: 456 Elm Street, New York, NY 10001, USA

raw_entities.name: Address Change Verification
raw_entities.description: Customer service representative verifies the address change request by reviewing proof of address documentation and validating the new address details.
context: Proof of Address: Utility bill (dated Jan 10, 2026)

raw_entities.name: KYC Status Update
raw_entities.description: KYC verification status is confirmed and updated following successful address change verification.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening for Address Change
raw_entities.description: AML screening is performed on the new address to assess jurisdictional and risk factors, with clearance status recorded.

raw_entities.name: Address Change Approval
raw_entities.description: Final approval decision is made on the address change request following successful verification and compliance clearance.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Representative
raw_entities.description: Customer service staff member responsible for verifying address change requests and reviewing proof of address documentation. In this instance, John Smith performed the verification.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer who initiates the address change request through the online channel.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory verification gate ensuring proof of address documentation is valid and current before address change is approved. Requires utility bill or equivalent proof dated within acceptable timeframe.
context: Proof of Address: Utility bill (dated Jan 10, 2026)

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory AML compliance gate that screens the new address jurisdiction and risk profile before approving the address change. Jurisdictional factors and sanctions exposure are evaluated.

raw_entities.name: Old Address
raw_entities.description: Customer's previous residential address in Manchester, United Kingdom, prior to permanent relocation.
context: Old Address: 123 Oak Lane, Manchester, M1 1AA, UK

raw_entities.name: New Address
raw_entities.description: Customer's new residential address in New York, United States, following permanent relocation.
context: New Address: 456 Elm Street, New York, NY 10001, USA

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address
raw_entities.description: Utility bill document dated January 10, 2026, used to verify the customer's new address during the address change process.
context: Proof of Address: Utility bill (dated Jan 10, 2026)

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification for Address Change
raw_entities.description: KYC verification process component confirming the customer's identity and address details are current and compliant following the address change.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening for New Address Jurisdiction
raw_entities.description: AML screening process evaluating the new US address for sanctions exposure and jurisdictional risk factors, resulting in low-risk clearance.

raw_entities.name: Address Change Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: Binary approval decision point determining whether the address change request is approved or rejected based on verification and compliance clearance outcomes.

relationships.description: The Address Change Process begins with the Address Change Initiation step where the customer initiates the address change request online.
Address Change Initiation is followed by Address Change Verification where the CSR verifies the address change request.
Address Change Verification is followed by KYC Status Update to ensure KYC compliance for the address change.
KYC Status Update is followed by AML Screening for Address Change to screen the new address jurisdiction.
AML Screening for Address Change is followed by Address Change Approval upon successful screening.
The Address Change Process includes the Address Change Verification step as a mandatory component.
The Address Change Process includes the KYC Status Update step.
The Address Change Process includes the AML Screening for Address Change step.
The Address Change Process concludes with the Address Change Approval step.
The Address Change Process is executed by the Customer Service Representative who verifies the address change.
The Address Change Process mandates inclusion of the Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint.
The Address Change Process mandates inclusion of the AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint.
The Address Change Process requires KYC Verification for Address Change to be completed.

relationships.target_name: AML Screening for New Address Jurisdiction
relationships.description: The Address Change Process requires AML Screening for New Address Jurisdiction to be completed.
The Address Change Process concludes at the Address Change Approval Gate decision point.
Address Change Initiation step collects address change data from the Customer.
Address Change Verification step is performed by the Customer Service Representative.
Address Change Verification step verifies the Proof of Address document.

relationships.description: Address Change Verification step satisfies the Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint.
KYC Status Update step executes the KYC Verification for Address Change.

Address Change Approval step routes to the Address Change Approval Gate decision point upon successful completion.
Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint gates the Address Change Approval Gate decision point.
AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint gates the Address Change Approval Gate decision point.
Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint requires collection of Proof of Address document.
